Tool use with the Messages API

Tool use with the Messages API

INTRO_DIV_SENTENCE Tools let a model call functions you define, receive their results, and continue the conversation with that new information. This introduction lives in a bare div rather than a paragraph element, which older extractors silently dropped after sanitisation.

How tool use works

Request flow

FLOW_DIV_SENTENCE You provide tool definitions, the model decides whether to call one, and you run the tool locally before sending the result back. Each of these steps is described below with enough prose to keep the readability scorer interested in this container.
Parameter reference
FieldTypeDescription
namestringTABLE_ROW_ONE Tool name, unique within the request.
input_schemaobjectTABLE_ROW_TWO JSON schema for the tool input.
tool_choice
DL_DEFINITION_ONE Controls whether the model must call a tool.
disable_parallel_tool_use
DL_DEFINITION_TWO Forces at most one tool call per turn.

Example request

curl https://api.example.test/v1/messages \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"demo","tools":[]}'

Line one of a paragraph
Line two after a break

  • BULLET_ONE define the tool
  • BULLET_TWO run it locally
  1. STEP_ONE send the definitions
  2. STEP_TWO return the result

QUOTE_SENTENCE Treat tool results as untrusted input.
